title: The connection between forum activity and the claim
shortTitle: The connection between forum activity and the claim
summary: Specific jurisdiction requires an appropriate connection between the defendant’s forum activity and the particular litigation. The assigned cases describe claims that arise out of or relate to those contacts.
notes: Ford does not make all business sufficient for all claims. Its recognition that relatedness is not limited to strict causation still requires a meaningful link to the particular controversy.

sections.Meaning: Specific jurisdiction requires an appropriate connection between the defendant’s forum activity and the particular litigation. The assigned cases describe claims that arise out of or relate to those contacts.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the product, activity, injury, and forum connections at the level relevant to the case. Ford examines a defendant’s cultivation of a market for the same products even though the particular vehicles were first sold elsewhere. Bristol-Myers rejects using extensive unrelated forum business to fill the gap for out-of-state claims.

priorAccount.title: Claim–contact relatedness
priorAccount.summary: Specific jurisdiction requires a qualifying relationship between the claim and the defendant’s forum contacts.
priorAccount.notes: Ford rejects its proposed strict causal prerequisite while retaining limits on relatedness.
